page_title: Automate your Instagram Content Creation, Designs, & Posting With Your Own AI Assistant

sources.entry: SocialStudio - AI for social media management.

summary.name: Social Studio
summary.one_liner: Social Studio is an AI assistant for Instagram that generates post content, lets you design posts in an editor, and schedules them directly to Instagram.
use_cases: Generating a month of Instagram posts with AI
Designing branded Instagram posts without Canva or Illustrator
Scheduling Instagram posts weeks or months ahead
summary.what_it_does:
Social Studio generates Instagram content from a single word or prompt using AI, with captions and trending hashtags generated automatically. It includes an editor where users can customize text, colours, shapes and other elements of a post, and it says it avoids relying only on templates. Users can schedule the content they create directly to Instagram for a week, month or longer. The page also lists a Feed Visualizer, support for multiple Instagram accounts, brand asset uploads, and downloading to a phone. A higher-tier plan mentions complete documentation, Figma working materials, 100GB cloud storage and up to 500 team members.</what_it_does>
